rules.title: Grouped Card must have an accessible label
rules.description: When a Card explicitly uses role='group', that group must have an accessible name. Plain Card surfaces may rely on surrounding section or aside semantics.
rules.expected: grouped element has an accessible name, commonly aria-labelledby pointing to a non-empty heading

conditions: aria-labelledby target has non-empty text content

rules.message: Card with role='group' is missing an accessible name.
rules.fix: Add aria-labelledby="[id-of-card-heading]" or another valid accessible name to the grouped Card. Omit a redundant group role when surrounding semantics already provide the relationship.

rules.title: Expandable card toggle must declare aria-expanded
rules.description: The .card__toggle button in an Expandable card must communicate its expanded/collapsed state via aria-expanded. Value must be 'true' or 'false' — never omitted.
rules.expected: element has aria-expanded='true' or aria-expanded='false' AND has non-empty aria-label

conditions: element has aria-expanded with value 'true' or 'false'

rules.message: Expandable card toggle is missing aria-expanded or aria-label. Screen reader users cannot determine the card's expansion state.
rules.fix: Add aria-expanded="false" (or "true") and aria-label="Expand card" to .card__toggle.

rules.title: Expandable card toggle must reference its controlled panel
rules.description: The .card__toggle button must carry aria-controls pointing to the id of .card__expandable-content. This connects the trigger to its panel for assistive technology.
rules.expected: element has aria-controls attribute whose value matches an existing element id

check.condition: aria-controls value matches id of an existing DOM element

rules.message: Expandable card toggle is missing aria-controls or the target element does not exist.
rules.fix: Add aria-controls="[id]" to .card__toggle and id="[matching-id]" to .card__expandable-content.

rules.title: Card focus indicator must not be suppressed
rules.description: The card stylesheet defines a visible focus indicator via :focus-within that changes the border to 2px solid black. Any override that removes this focus indicator violates WCAG 2.4.7.
rules.expected: computed border-width is 2px and border-color is not transparent or matching background
rules.message: Card focus-within indicator is suppressed or overridden. Keyboard users may not see which card is active.
rules.fix: Remove any override that changes border-width or border-color on :focus-within for .card--expandable or .card--selectable.

rules.title: Selectable card checkbox must have an accessible label
rules.description: The checkbox inside .card__checkbox-wrapper must have an accessible name so screen reader users understand what they are selecting.
rules.expected: checkbox has accessible name via associated <label> OR aria-label OR aria-labelledby

conditions: element has associated <label> via for/id pairing
element has aria-labelledby pointing to non-empty element

rules.message: Selectable card checkbox is missing an accessible label. Screen reader users cannot identify what they are selecting.
rules.fix: Add a <label for="[checkbox-id]">Select this card</label> or aria-label to the checkbox. A visually hidden label (.sr-only) is acceptable.

rules.title: Interactive card child elements must use semantic elements
rules.description: The .card__toggle must be a <button> element. The checkbox in .card__checkbox-wrapper must be an <input type='checkbox'>. Using non-interactive elements for these controls breaks keyboard access.
rules.expected: .card__toggle tag is 'button'. Checkbox inside .card__checkbox-wrapper is input[type='checkbox'].
rules.message: Card interactive element uses incorrect element type. .card__toggle must be <button>. Checkbox must be <input type='checkbox'>.
rules.fix: Use <button class="card__toggle" type="button"> for the expand trigger. Use <input type="checkbox"> for the selection control.

rules.title: Colors must reference design tokens, not hardcoded values
rules.description: All color values applied to .card elements must reference CSS custom properties (var(--token-name)). Hardcoded hex, rgb(), or hsl() values as primary values bypass the token system.
rules.expected: background, color, border-color all use var(--) — or are transparent, none, inherit, currentColor
rules.message: Hardcoded color '{value}' found on '{property}'. Replace with the corresponding --card-* design token.
rules.fix: Replace e.g. background: #F9FAFB with var(--card-bg-hover). See token surface in card.contract.md §12.

rules.title: Card must not use physical CSS properties that break RTL
rules.description: Physical directional properties on .card or its children cause visual defects under dir='rtl'. The card uses flex-direction: column which is direction-neutral. Physical horizontal properties should not be added.
rules.expected: padding-left, padding-right, margin-left, margin-right, border-left, border-right are absent
rules.message: Physical CSS property '{property}' found on card element. This will cause layout defects under dir='rtl'.
rules.fix: Replace padding-left/right with padding-inline-start/end. Remove horizontal directional margins from card children.
